sections.content: To express hunger, thirst, and taste, Hungarian uses predicates: 'szomjas' (thirsty), 'éhes' (hungry), 'finom' (delicious).

items.spanish: Nem vagyok szomjas, de éhes vagyok.
items.english: I am not thirsty, but I am hungry.

sections.content: Notice: 'szomjas vagyok' (thirsty I am), not 'szomjasan'. Use the adjective with the verb 'van' (to be).
